name: Wang Tile Mapper
definition: A method that maps Wang squares and cubes to the prisms of shell space or boxes of core space, linking µLAS and mLAS in a three-level AS tree. It transforms molecular instances from Wang square coordinates to texture coordinates of a mesh, and from Wang cube coordinates to the AABB of a mesh.
summary: The Wang Tile Mapper efficiently maps molecular instances to 3D mesh geometry for volume rendering using pre-generated tiling recipes and a sliding window approach.
